guidance_for_write_dockerfile_agent: The Dockerfile build fails at step 6 with error: '/bin/bash: line 1: -o: command not found'. This is caused by incorrect usage of the curl command inside the RUN instruction in the Dockerfile. The curl command and its parameters should be enclosed in quotes or the shell form RUN should be used properly. The current command interprets '-o' as a command instead of a curl option because the ampersand '&' and '?' characters in the URL are not escaped or quoted, causing shell parsing issues. To fix, update the RUN command to properly quote the URL and parameters to prevent shell interpretation issues. For example, replace: RUN curl -fsSL https://keyserver.ubuntu.com/pks/lookup?op=get&search=0x6A755776 -o /usr/share/keyrings/deadsnakes-archive-keyring.gpg with RUN curl -fsSL "https://keyserver.ubuntu.com/pks/lookup?op=get&search=0x6A755776" -o /usr/share/keyrings/deadsnakes-archive-keyring.gpg or use the exec form: RUN ["curl", "-fsSL", "https://keyserver.ubuntu.com/pks/lookup?op=get&search=0x6A755776", "-o", "/usr/share/keyrings/deadsnakes-archive-keyring.gpg"] . This fix will allow the Dockerfile to build successfully and proceed with environment setup.
